notes: PaperbirdToken takes no constructor arguments and mints 1,000,000,000 PAPERBIR with 18 decimals once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. It supports ERC-20 transfers, allowance-based burning and ERC-2612 permit, with no owner, administrative controls, transfer fees or further minting. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
